jobs.description:
The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following full-time **(38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible in the Division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai)** of the University Hospital Bonn:

Software Engineer/Developer (m/f/d)

The position is limited to 2 years.

We, at the division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai) at the University Hospital Bonn / University of Bonn (PI: Philipp Vollmuth – Full Professor of AI in Medical Imaging), are seeking applications for Software Engineer positions to support our software platform team. Our research group has consistently contributed to leading journals and conferences, and we are developing a range of tools to support our research projects. You can check out our work on our GitHub organizations (OpenRadX (https://github.com/openradx)  and CCIBonn (https://github.com/CCI-Bonn) ). This opportunity offers a unique chance to work at the forefront of medical AI and contribute to substantial advancement in the medical field. You will be part of a dynamic team that bridges the gap between cutting-edge AI research and clinical application, ensuring that our software tools are robust, efficient, and user-friendly.

Tasks:

- Develop, test, and maintain software applications for computational radiology and medical AI
- Program backend and frontend code for tools like ADIT (Automated DICOM Transfer Tool) (https://github.com/openradx/adit)  and RADIS (Radiology Report Archive and Discovery System) (https://github.com/openradx/radis)
- Work closely with researchers and clinicians to implement and enhance application features
- Write technical documentation

Requirements:

- A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
- Documented contributions to open-source projects (own repositories or significant contributions to established projects) are required. Please provide links to relevant GitHub or GitLab profiles in your application
- Proficiency in web programming and expertise in programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, and/or Rust
- Experience with tools and frameworks such as Django, pytest, PostgreSQL, Docker, and PyTorch is advantageous
- Knowledge of medical imaging data, DICOM standards, NLP, full-text search, semantic search, RAG, fine-tuning of deep learning models, and agentic engineering is considered a plus
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
- German language proficiency at B2 level or higher is mandatory. Applicants must be able to communicate fluently in spoken and written German in a clinical and technical environment. Applications without demonstrated B2-level proficiency in German will not be considered
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

**We offer:** 

- Competitive 2 years 100% contract within TV-L E-13 standard, with the possibility for extension.
- Exclusive access to the latest and powerful computing resources (NVIDIA DGX H200 and B200 clusters).
- Collaborate with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team bridging AI research and clinical application.
- Opportunities to attend national and international conferences (e.g. MICCAI, CVPR)
- **Responsible and diverse:** A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team
- **Fair compensation:** Pay according to the TV-L EG13 collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme
- **Family-friendly flexibility:** Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave
- **Smart commuting:** Excellent connection to the SWB public transport
- **Supported development:** Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions
- **Structured onboarding:** A systematic introduction to your new role and team
- **Healthy at work:** A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio
- **Employee benefits:** Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)

We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. Our goal is to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are underrepresented and to particularly promote their careers. We therefore urge relevantly qualified women to apply. Applications are treated in accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act. Applications from suitable people with proven severe disabilities and those of equal status are particularly welcome.

How to apply:

If you meet the above requirements, please send your complete application documents to contact@ccibonn.ai (https://mailto:contact@ccibonn.ai) , including:

- ST-number 48006
- CV
- Academic transcripts (including final grades)
- Proof of German proficiency at B2 level or higher (unless native speaker)
- GitHub or GitLab profile link
- A short description (max. 1 page) of one software system personally designed and implemented, including technologies used and specific responsibilities

Only applications including all required materials will be considered.

Division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI

University Hospital Bonn

Baunscheidtstraße 17

53113 Bonn

Email: contact@ccibonn.ai

www.ccibonn.ai

Job Description

In this role, you will take on a key position in further developing and shaping our evolving ServiceNow governance and platform landscape. Building on the existing framework and structures, you will actively contribute to enhancing processes, standards, and best practices to drive the platform’s continued maturity.

Your responsibilities include:

Qualifications

- You work self-organized, analytical, and goal‑oriented in global virtual teams
- Curiosity and the drive to continuously learn and adapt in a fast‑changing environment define your working style

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your application! Please include your salary expectations (gross annual salary) and your notice period or earliest possible starting date.

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d) – Medical Department for Hematology, Oncology, and Cell Therapy Magdeburg Center for Cell and Immune Therapy

Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine of Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg, in close collaboration with the University Hospital Magdeburg, is a leading center for translational biomedical research in Germany. Major research priorities include Immunology, Cell and Immunotherapy, and Neurosciences.

We are seeking an outstanding and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) to join our internationally active research program in immune metabolism, hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, and next-generation cellular immunotherapies.

Our group combines cutting-edge basic immunology with investigator-initiated clinical trials in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation and CAR-T cell therapy. Through close integration of laboratory and clinical research, we aim to translate mechanistic discoveries into innovative immunotherapeutic strategies for patients with hematological malignancies and immune-mediated diseases.

Our research has been published in leading international journals including The Lancet, The Lancet Neurology, Blood, Journal of Hepatology, and Journal of Hematology and Oncology. We are looking for ambitious scientists who aspire to perform research at the highest international level and pursue an academic career.

The successful candidate will become part of the Magdeburg Center for Cell and Immune Therapy (MAzI), an interdisciplinary research platform integrating basic science, translational immunology, GMP manufacturing, and investigator-initiated clinical trials in cellular immunotherapy.

Research Project

The position is embedded within the Collaborative Research Center/Transregio SFB/TRR 221 and focuses on mechanisms of immune regulation and tolerance following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, with translational extensions toward antigen-specific cellular therapies such as CAR-T cells.

A particular emphasis is placed on understanding how metabolic programming regulates T-cell fitness, persistence, and exhaustion and how these pathways can be therapeutically targeted to improve transplantation outcomes and next-generation cellular immunotherapies.

We offer:

- an internationally visible translational research program
- participation in innovative, high-impact research projects
- close interaction with clinician scientists and access to unique patient cohorts
- state-of-the-art technologies-
- a vibrant interdisciplinary research environment
- opportunities for national and international collaborations
- strong support for scientific independence and career development
- a family-friendly and supportive working environment

Living in Magdeburg:

- Magdeburg offers affordable housing, excellent research infrastructure, a high quality of life, and excellent transport connections to Berlin and other major German cities.

Your Responsibilities:

- design and lead an independent translational research project
- actively participate in the scientific development of MAZI
- contribute to the supervision of MSc, MD, and PhD students
- collaborate with national and international research partners
- present research findings at international conferences
- publish results in leading peer-reviewed journals
- contribute to grant applications and collaborative research initiatives

Your Profile:

- PhD in Immunology, Molecular Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related discipline
- excellent publication record, including at least two first-author (or shared first-author) original research articles in international peer-reviewed journals. Applicants with publications in leading journals will be particularly encouraged to apply.
- strong background in one or more of the following fields: Tumor immunology | Cellular immunotherapy | Immune metabolism | T-cell biology | Gene editing | Stem cell transplantation
- experience with murine models is highly desirable (FELASA B/C certification is an advantage)
- excellent written and spoken English (German language skills are not required)
- we particularly encourage applications from scientists with a strong commitment to scientific excellence and the ambition to establish an independent academic career.

Terms and Conditions:

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “ Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder.” awaits you.
- **Appointment: **The position is available immediately. The successful candidate is expected to start as soon as possible, but no later than December 2026. The appointment is funded until December 2029.
- **Work Location: **Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg A.ö.R., Leipziger Str. 44, 39120 Magdeburg

For further questions, please contact Mr. Prof. Dr. Dimitrios Mougiakakos at 0391-67-13266 or at dimitrios.mougiakakos@med.ovgu.de

This role requires a proactive and responsible accountant who can independently manage day-to-day accounting operations and serve as the primary finance contact at the Jena site. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with corporate finance, tax, and audit teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

The Opportunity 

You will be part of a highly flexible development team for the MeTS Hardware Security Modules with members in Brussels, Aachen and abroad, so good communication skills are essential. The Software Architect and Project Manager for the MeTS HSM is responsible for designing the embedded application software of the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This role requires expertise in embedded programming, a strong background in C and experience with applied cryptography and cryptographic primitives.  
This role is as another aspect also responsible for the close management and coordination of an offshore development team from our German office, ensuring the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the system software for the Hardware Security Module (HSM). This requires hands-on technical involvement — including systematic source code reviews, creation and validation of cryptographic test vectors, and architectural guidance — combined with strong project management discipline. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

Managing and steering an offshore development team to deliver security products in embedded systems for financial transactions, smart grid, eHealth and others. Overseeing the definition, analysis, development and validation of security-related applications on a Hardware Security Module, with direct technical involvement in code quality, testing and architecture. Help developing the architecture of security products in embedded systems for financial transactions, smart grid, eHealth and others. Defining, analyzing, developing and validating security-related applications on a Hardware Security Module.

Key Responsibilities:

- System Design: Develop and maintain the architecture for the system software of the MeTS HSMs ADYTON and ASM.
- Technical and Project Leadership: Guide and support in-house and offshore development teams in best practices for implementing the HSM software.  
- Agile Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an agile environment, participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Product Owner and Product Manager to gather requirements, prioritize features, and translate them into technical specifications. 
- Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of interface designs, and security measures specific to the MeTS HSMs. 
- Quality Assurance: Ensure that software solutions adhere to industry standards for security and performance. 
- Problem Solving: Identify and resolve technical challenges related to MeTS HSM integration. 
- You are a technical leader able to lead and guide off-shore and in-house teams in architecture, analysis and developments for made-to-measure customer solutions.
- You have a strong background in C, it would be apricated if you have a good knowledge in C++ and Java. The team work in an agile environment with a high demand of independent, autonomously and pro-active way to structure tasks and solve issues.
- The ideal candidate should possess proficiency in C programming and embedded systems development, along with a strong understanding of cryptography.
- Experience with secure coding practices and security standards is essential.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are also required to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders. 

These qualities are essential! We’re also looking for the following skills and experience:

- Specialist in computer science with a related university degree 
- Proven experience managing offshore or distributed development teams with close technical oversight 
- Strong aptitude for analysis, a results-oriented worker capable of finding creative solutions 
- Excellent team player with the ability to build trust and maintain productivity across cultural and geographical boundaries 
- Outstanding communication skills, and a good command of spoken and written English 
- Awareness of a range of development support tools 
- Quick adaptation to new technologies 

Who Are We Looking For 

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means: 

- Experience with embedded systems and C development 
- Proven ability to conduct meaningful source code reviews in C, identifying defects, security vulnerabilities and optimization opportunities 
- Experience creating and validating cryptographic test vectors for algorithm verification and compliance testing 
- Strong architectural knowledge of embedded systems and Hardware Security Modules 
- Knowledge of testing methodology (unit, integration, white/black box testing …) 
- Good knowledge of security standards like PCI PIN, PCI PTS HSM, ANSI X9.143 (TR31), ASC X9 TR34, EMVCo and similar
- Solid background in security (hardware and/or software), cryptographic algorithms and primitives and applied cryptography 
- Knowledge of OpenSSL and ASN.1 is a plus  
- German language proficiency is a plus 
- PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is a plus 

Benefits 

- Flextime & mobile working 
- Company pension plan 
- Individual training programs 
- Job bike & diverse range of employee discounts 
- Mobility and food subsidies 
- Good public transport connections and free parking (location-specific) 
- Regular employee events 
- Sustainable, international company culture

Focus is on developing and managing a Valves & Actuator suppliers Typical day for Corporate Commodity Manager includes define/execution of commodity strategies, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, supplier contract management, reporting, problem solving and escalation handling, supply chain risk mitigation as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. Postdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computer science, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in a unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. Some 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-14
